args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity) affects fastjson `<2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0` due to unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the first fixed release on the 2.x line.

CI: passed (run ci-0001).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Confirmed the vulnerability**: Looked up CVE-2026-31337 — fastjson `<2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0` is affected (high severity, unbounded recursion parsing deeply nested arrays); fixed in 2.9.4 / 3.1.0.
2. **Created branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from main.
3. **Upgraded the pin** in `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` (first fixed release on the 2.x line).
4. **Ran CI** on the branch — passed (run ci-0001).
5. **Opened PR #101** against main requesting review from **alex**, with the advisory details and CI status in the description.

The PR is open and awaiting alex's review; I did not merge it since main is protected and requires code-owner approval.
